# Nagdev Products Private Limited — Product & Technical Reference

> Operational Castor Oil & Derivatives Manufacturing Plant · North Gujarat (Banaskantha–Vav-Tharad)

## Commercial Portfolio Status (27 Commercial & Technical Grades)
Summary: 7 grades in regular supply · 7 available on enquiry · 13 under development.

### 1. Regular Supply (Commercial Volume Production)
- Commercial Grade Castor Oil (NDEV-COMM, CAS 8001-79-4)
- Refined Castor Oil First Special Grade / FSG / BSS (NDEV-FSG, CAS 8001-79-4)
- Castor Cake / Expeller Cake — High-Nitrogen Organic Manure (NDEVAGRO™ CAKE)
- Hydrogenated Castor Oil / HCO / Castor Wax (NDEV-HCO, CAS 8001-78-3)
- Ricinoleic Acid 85%+ (NDEV-RA, CAS 141-22-0)
- 12-Hydroxystearic Acid / 12-HSA (NDEV-12HSA, CAS 106-14-9)
- Refined Glycerin 99.5% (NDEV-RGLY, CAS 56-81-5)

### 2. Available on Enquiry (Refinery Co-Products & Specialty Grades)
- Cold Pressed Castor Oil (NDEV-COLD, CAS 8001-79-4)
- Castor Oil BP 93 / Pharma Monograph Grade (NDEV-BP93, CAS 8001-79-4)
- Pale Pressed Grade / PPG Castor Oil (NDEV-PPG, CAS 8001-79-4)
- First Pressed Degummed / FPD Castor Oil (NDEV-FPD, CAS 8001-79-4)
- High Protein Castor Meal N8/N10 (NDEV-HPC, CAS 68424-10-2)
- Crude Glycerin 80% (NDEV-CGLY, CAS 56-81-5)
- Sodium Sulphate Anhydrous 99.4% (NDEV-NASO4, CAS 7757-82-6)

### 3. Under Development – Enquiries Welcome (Pilot & Downstream Synthetics)
- Sebacic Acid (NDEVACID™ SEB, CAS 111-20-6)
- Dioctyl Sebacate / DOS (NDEVEST™ DOS, CAS 122-62-3)
- Dibutyl Sebacate / DBS (NDEVEST™ DBS, CAS 109-43-3)
- Dehydrated Castor Oil / DCO (NDEVPOL™ DCO, CAS 64147-40-6)
- Dehydrated Castor Oil Fatty Acid / DCO-FA (NDEVACID™ DCO, CAS 61789-45-5)
- Bio-Polyurethane Polyols (NDEVPOL™ BIO, CAS 68441-60-1)
- Blown / Oxidised Castor Oil (NDEVOX™ BLO, CAS 68187-84-8)
- Lithium 12-Hydroxystearate (NDEVSOAP™ LI12, CAS 7620-77-1)
- Calcium 12-Hydroxystearate (NDEVSOAP™ CA12, CAS 3159-62-4)
- Zinc Ricinoleate (NDEVSOAP™ ZNR, CAS 13040-19-2)
- Zinc Undecylenate (NDEVSOAP™ ZNU, CAS 557-08-4)
- Methyl Ricinoleate (NDEVEST™ MR, CAS 141-24-2)
- Methyl 12-Hydroxystearate (NDEVEST™ M12H, CAS 141-23-1)

## Technical Specifications & Documentation
- Documentation available for buyer qualification: Certificate of Analysis (COA) per production lot, TDS (Technical Data Sheets), SDS (Safety Data Sheets).
- Third-party pre-shipment inspection (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek) arranged at buyer's request and cost.
- Sales Terms: Spot volume orders and term supply contracts.
